yearLayout: UInt24LE: bits 0..12 sequential month length (0=29, 1=30); bits 13..16 leapAfter (0=no leap); bits 17..23 reserved zero
generator: Build-time System.Globalization.ChineseLunisolarCalendar: GetMonthsInYear, GetDaysInMonth, GetLeapMonth minus one; runtime consumes frozen bytes only.
verification: All 36525 supported Gregorian dates compared with frozen lunar-2000-2099-v1.bin lunar year/month/day/leap tuple.
calendarFieldReference: Power query fxCalendar.m (MIT Copyright 2023 焦棚子)
dataSource: Microsoft .NET ChineseLunisolarCalendar calendar facts; .NET runtime source distributed under MIT license https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/LICENSE.TXT
scope: Astronomical lunar dates only; no official holiday or compensating workday schedule.
